purpose: Executable ledger for the `semantic-ontology-language` route-support family; normalized schema envelope added in rev0293.
non_promotion_rule: Ontology-commitment rows declare what kind of entity, structure, operation, or noncommitment is licensed. They prevent ontic relabeling from changing route authority.

commitment_rows.operational_target: allowed operational content is limited to the public carrier/protocol/evidence-unit/update rows already declared for the route
